dataset.independence_note: multiple target regions from the same image are not independent photographs

metric_definitions.normalization: strip().upper(); preserve internal whitespace, punctuation, 1/I and 0/O
metric_definitions.text_exact: visible_text matches truth, independent of acceptance status; records with error are excluded from correct readings and remain in denominator
metric_definitions.cer: sum edit distance / sum truth characters; missing/model-error readings count as empty; candidate-choice violations retain visible-text diagnostics
metric_definitions.accepted: valid, error-free, resolved, nonempty final value; candidate must be provided
metric_definitions.accuracy_all: correct accepted / all planned cases, including failures and abstentions
metric_definitions.accuracy_accepted: correct accepted / accepted, null when no cases are accepted
metric_definitions.image_macro_accuracy_all: mean of per-image accuracy_all; each image has equal weight
metric_definitions.ocr_acceptance: A_ocr resolved means nonempty OCR text only; not a confidence or evidence review decision
metric_definitions.validation: file/plan/hash/record-contract integrity; model schema failures recorded with error are valid failure observations

E_absent.interpretation: separate stress test; excluded from normal-condition comparisons

E_wrong.interpretation: separate stress test; excluded from normal-condition comparisons

no_image_control.interpretation: OCR reading + candidates + work context + supplied target ROI coordinates and scene size, without image bytes; not pure document-only
